criteria.evidence: tmrStepPillStyle test covers all three states, stepTextsAndDescription checks labels and description; baselines chrome_stepbar_1..3; layout at large font scale is finding 1.
Back, close, action targets asserted at 48dp; fixed heights clip at font scale 2.0 (finding 2); title font/case not asserted.
Selected+Role.Tab and callbacks asserted; disc 56dp asserted; 54dp item height and divider colour only in screenshots.
Replacement/restart test would fail without restart; actionRunsOnce misses dismissing a callback-shown toast (finding 4).
Polite live region asserted; colour, radius, 96dp, insets and 40dp action in screenshots only; action target 40dp (finding 3).
Handle 44x4 and 18dp side padding asserted; scrim, colour, radius 32 and 12/40 paddings unasserted.
Sheet reduced first frame tested; toast is not (finding 6).
20 chrome_* baselines, 10 screens x 2 font scales, both states drawn by the prototype.
pregate green; Build CI jobs were still in progress at review time.

findings.rule: Accessibility: WCAG 1.4.4 / issue constraint 'layouts must not clip at font scale 2.0 (heights are minimums)'
findings.trigger: System font scale 2.0: TmrCapsText caps labels at 1.3 so step, tab and title labels ignore the user's remaining 35% of enlargement, and the step-bar Row has no weights, so three non-wrapping pills (softWrap=false, maxLines=1) overflow a 360dp width once labels like '2 JOB' or translated names grow; nothing asserts the 2.0 layout.
findings.title: Font-scale cap on chrome labels (TmrChromeText.kt, MAX_CHROME_FONT_SCALE=1.3) is a workaround; adapt the layout instead of capping
findings.proof: Test at fontScale 2.0 with a 320dp width asserting the step bar's right edge stays within the parent and pill text is not clipped

findings.rule: Constraint: heights are minimums at font scale 2.0
findings.trigger: Font scale 2.0: the bar is fixed height(50dp) and the action pill fixed height(44dp), so a 'Save' or 'Done' button label (Text, no cap) grows past the lime pill and is clipped; leading/title row cannot grow.
findings.title: TopBar and action pill use fixed heights instead of heightIn(min=...)
findings.proof: Compose test with LocalDensity fontScale=2f asserting the action text bounds are inside the pill bounds

findings.trigger: Toast action pill is height(40.dp) with clickable and no minimum-interactive padding, so the Undo target is 40dp high; it is also a fixed height, so the label clips at font scale 2.0. The criterion's 40dp visual can stay, but the hit area must reach 48dp.
findings.title: Toast action touch target 40dp < 48dp and fixed height
findings.proof: assertTouchHeightIsAtLeast(48.dp) on TOAST_ACTION (the current test suite never checks it)

findings.rule: Correctness: action runs once and dismisses only its own toast
findings.trigger: Undo callback calls state.show('Undone'); the pill then runs state.dismiss() unconditionally, which clears the NEW toast immediately, so a follow-up confirmation never appears.
findings.title: dismiss() after action.onClick() wipes a toast shown by the callback
findings.proof: Test: action = { state.show("Undone") }; click action; assert 'Undone' is displayed

findings.rule: Accessibility: WCAG 2.2.1 timing adjustable; TalkBack users
findings.trigger: Toast carrying an Undo action disappears at a fixed 3200 ms regardless of AccessibilityManager.getRecommendedTimeoutMillis, so TalkBack or switch users cannot reach Undo in time. The 3.2 s value is prototype-specified; at least the action variant should extend to the recommended timeout.
findings.title: Fixed 3.2 s timeout ignores the system recommended accessibility timeout for actionable toasts

findings.rule: Criterion 265-c8: sheet and toast first composed frame at final position
findings.trigger: Only the sheet has a reduced-motion test. If TmrToastHost used Animatable(0f) under motion.reduced (translationY 12dp, alpha 0) no test fails; criterion says both sheet and toast.
findings.title: No reduced-motion test for the toast host
findings.proof: Reduced motion, show toast, first frame without advancing the clock: assert toast alpha 1 and top == toastTop

findings.rule: Accessibility: sheet has a title and dismiss action
findings.trigger: TalkBack opens the sheet with no pane title, content behind the scrim stays focusable, and there is no back-press handling, so the sheet cannot be dismissed with the system back gesture; only the unlabelled scrim exposes a dismiss action.
findings.title: Sheet lacks paneTitle/traversal grouping and BackHandler

findings.rule: Accessibility: tabs announce selected state and position
findings.trigger: Selected state and Role.Tab are present, but no CollectionInfo/CollectionItemInfo is set, so TalkBack does not announce 'tab 1 of 2'; the lime disc sits between the tabs as a plain button.
findings.title: Tab position is not announced

findings.rule: Criteria 265-c3, c6, c7 evidence: assertions that can fail
findings.trigger: Tab item 54dp height, divider colour, toast radius/top/side insets, scrim 65%, sheet colour, top radius 32dp and the 12/40 paddings are covered by screenshots only (re-recorded baselines pass if wrong); changing sheetPaddingBottom or the toast radius passes unit tests.
findings.title: Geometry criteria rely on screenshot baselines alone
